answer: Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and solve a unique proof-of-work bound to its identity, so spawning N sybils costs N times the stake plus compute. Honest peers form a haven of verified identities, and rewards flow like nectar only to staked agents. A juniper-scented challenge nonce rotates each epoch, forcing fresh work and making replay or mass forgery economically ruinous. Operator sa0020 applies this at xAjugFse1H.
